items.title: A protective gene sent to the liver cleared amyloid from mouse brains, sparking hope for an Alzheimer’s gene therapy
items.summary_en: The calling card of Alzheimer’s disease is a buildup of misfolded amyloid protein in the brain, but many medicines struggle to penetrate the barrier protecting the mind from outside interference. A new study suggests that crossing the blood-brain barrier might not be necessary at all to clear amyloid plaques—and that a one-time gene therapy could one day prove an effective treatment for the devastating neurodegenerative disease.
items.korean_summary:
간에 유전자를 전달해 뇌의 아밀로이드 플라크를 제거하는 알츠하이머 유전자치료 전략이 마우스 모델에서 제시됨.
혈뇌장벽(BBB) 통과 없이 간 발현 단백질이 뇌 아밀로이드를 청소하는 메커니즘, 1회 투여 gene therapy 형태.
알츠하이머 치료의 BBB 우회 전략으로서 gene therapy 가능성을 보여주나 아직 전임상 단계.
